subject: Roadshow lead-capture ops & consent language for Q4 sponsors
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

Hi Karthik and Marissa,

Thanks for confirming Redwood as a sponsor for the West Coast roadshow series. A couple of ops items we need to lock down this week so our onsite team and the cloud badge vendor can be ready: 

- Which badge scanner vendor do you prefer (our default is ScanFast) or do you want to bring your own unit?
- Lead export cadence: immediate push (webhook) to HubSpot vs. end-of-day CSV?
- Consent language: we need final copy for badges and the opt-in checkbox on the scan screen.

I attached the scanner spec we use most often. Also copying our expo ops alias so they can align on logistics.

Attachments: badge_scanner_spec.pdf (pdf, 420KB)

Best,
Lisa Gomez
Partnerships, ExpoWorks
expo-ops@eventservices.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

Thanks Lisa — looping Ben and Marissa on the technical + CRM parts. Quick thoughts: 

- We're open to ScanFast but would prefer bringing one Redwood-configured scanner if vendor firmware can support a compact HTTP webhook (no SFTP). We can test on Tuesday.
- HubSpot integration: preferred is near-real-time push to a staging endpoint, then a validated mapping to production. End-of-day CSV only as fallback.
- Consent: we need a short on-screen line plus an email follow-up checkbox. Ben — can you draft the minimal legal-friendly copy that also satisfies EU privacy constraints (we have attendees from CA/EU)?

I skimmed the spec you attached; looks fine. Can ExpoWorks confirm power/network layout for the booth (we prefer PoE for the scanner)?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

On Fri, Oct 1, 2026 at 11:15 AM, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> - HubSpot integration: preferred is near-real-time push to a staging endpoint, then a validated mapping to production. End-of-day CSV only as fallback.

Adding operational detail:
- We can consume webhook POSTs in our staging HubSpot account (dev.redwood@hubspot) and auto-create contacts with source=event_roadshow. Need the schema: recommended fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, job_title, event_id, opt_in_email (boolean), captured_at (ISO8601), scanner_id.
- If webhook isn't possible, vendor CSV must match the attached hubspot-field-mapping.csv (I created the mapping).
- Consent language (draft below) — short + checkbox + email follow-up option: 
  "By scanning my badge, I consent to receive marketing communications from Redwood Inference. I understand my data will be processed according to Redwood's Privacy Policy and can be unsubscribed at any time."

Notes on privacy: for EU/UK attendees we need to record consent=true and store the consent text version and timestamp. For CA, we should capture a simple opt_in_email flag.

Attachments: hubspot-field-mapping.csv, consent-sample.txt

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

Thanks Ben — that mapping is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- ScanFast supports HTTP POST to an external endpoint (they call it webhook) but payloads are compact; they include a scanner_id and badge_id, and optionally names/emails if the badge is pre-registered.
- For unregistered walk-ups the scan returns only badge_id and timestamp; we can enrich with badge registry if you share your event_id and registry export nightly.
- Consent display: ScanFast's on-screen copy is limited to ~160 characters. We can show your short line and an opt-in toggle for email. They can also send a confirmation email if you provide an SMTP domain or authorize our Mail relay.

We can schedule a 30 minute tech-check on Tuesday 10/6 at 2pm PT to test scanning to your staging endpoint. Is that ok?

—Lisa

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T07:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

Hi all — schedule confirmed for Tue 10/6 2:00pm PT. Operational checklist I'm bringing to the call: 

1) Staging webhook URL (we'll provide): https://staging-hubspot-webhook.redwood.com/events/scan
2) Field mapping verification (attached) — Ben, please confirm column names match HubSpot import template.
3) Consent wording: final edit below for the ScanFast screen (<=160 chars):
   "By scanning my badge I agree to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference. See our Privacy Policy."
   We'll capture "consent_text_version": "scanfast_160_v1" and timestamp.
4) Fallback process: daily CSV upload to private S3 bucket (s3://redwood-ops/roadshow/exports/) — our platform will ingest and dedupe.
5) DocuSign: I've sent a Mutual Action Plan for ExpoWorks sponsorship (DocuSign link below). Please review.

Attachments: Roadshow_MutualActionPlan_v1.docx
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sessions/ABCDEF123456

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@expoworks.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Roadshow badge scanners + lead export cadence

Ack — appreciate the checklist. On the call we'll verify PoE availability and test the webhook to staging. If all green we'll flip to production webhook and set a 24-hour fallback CSV.

Karthik
